title: Computer Graphics: Main Exam, 23 April 2018
programme: Bachelor of Business Information Technology / information Technology
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A AND ANY OTHER TWO FROM SECTION B.

parts.text: In Autodesk Maya, discuss what hardware rendering is and its advantages.
Discuss how the mental ray for Maya renderer works in shading surfaces.
To display on a computer screen the programmer needs to poke the video memory. Discuss how memory mapping works.
State FOUR major applications of computer graphics.
Using the Bresenham's line drawing algorithm, scan convert the line starting at point (5,5) and ending at (20,18).
Discuss how you create shadows using a spotlight in Autodesk Maya.
Demonstrate the display mechanism of Cathode Ray Tube screens.
Outline FOUR disadvantages of OLED computer screens.
In transformations, rotate by 90 degrees clockwise an object with the following endpoints: (2,2), (3,4), (4,2).
Discuss the problems associated with the Digital Differential Analyzer line drawing algorithm.
Using the midpoint circle drawing algorithm, scan a circle centred on the origin with a radius of 5 units.
Discuss any three raster image file formats.
In realistic rendering, why is bump mapping important?
Given an object with the endpoints (2,2), (2,4), (4,4) and (4,2), can you reduce the object's size by 50% using the appropriate transformation technique?
Differentiate between orthographic and oblique projection.
Citing the major features, describe what presentation graphics software is.
